text_block_list.text:
One day, we came to the infirmary to have <chrname> 
checked out.
Oh, yes, yeees! A custo… a student!

Injury? Illness? Or mental care? No 
matter, just leave it all to me!

Huh? Well, I'm in the infirmary. …I'm a 
little bit of a fantastic health teacher? 
Sort of?

A-haha, I can't fool you, can I? I think 
I'll just go with a normal name.
Oho! I won't hide anything about me――

The savior who (supposedly) guides many 
Uma Musume! The (self-proclaimed) 
legendary bamboo needle-er with miraculous 
skills!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Shinzami Anshinnzawa! ! Whoa, 
Anshi～n☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Senseeei!! A suspicious person!! There's a 
suspicious person heeeere!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it really doesn't look like you're 
worried.☆

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
Wellwellwellwell, for the time being. Now 
that we've introduced ourselves, let's get 
ugly, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hisss! What's with the… stab-er!? 
W-w-w-what are your intentions with that 
thing!?

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
A-ha-ha! Don't sweat it, alright? Just 
poking a little secret hole with my secret 
bamboo needle.

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
Then, you'll beee――, super-duper fast… 
super-duper tough… Anyways, you'll have a 
ton of suuuuper great things happen to 
you!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
Ah! For the record, I'm not suspicious! 
I've never failed at anything even once 
before!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text: ……My master, that is.

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well, this is my first job, 
I've never made a mistake in the broadest 
sense of the word!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
I've had the experience of taking a class 
on tea with… no, sorry, training under a 
legendary master for 10 years.

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text: Waaow, Ansh～in☆
choice_data_list: (Suspicious enough to jump out at you…!)

text_block_list.text:
There was no way I was going to get sucked 
into this story. I was about to leave with 
<chrname>, but――

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text: W, waitwaitwait, wait, waaaait!!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
You're Sakura Bakushin O, aren't you!? 
You're the class president who's always 
chasing speed, trying to be a role model 
for anyone and everyone!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
Of course I know! I've watched her!! I'm a 
fan!!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
I'm here to cheer you on! I'm here to help 
you, with this!!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
So pleaaaaase～～～!! Please give me a 
chaaance～!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I… If it's the kindness of such a 
passionate fan, I can't let it go 
unnoticed…

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
Pleasepleasepleaaase! I'll even let you 
pick which vital point you want me to 
prick!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text: I toooootally won't fail at all～!!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text: …Probably.

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, not probably, maybe close to 
absolutely? Sort of? …Well, the details 
don't matter!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
What kind of secrets will you aim for!? 
There's the ability boost, the health 
boost… Charm boost, you name it!!

…This reeks of danger, but there's a 
possibility that it could be very 
effective… a possibility.
What should I do…?
choice_data_list:
Aim for the vital point that'll make a 
strong Uma Musume.
Target the vital point that wins races.

Aim for the vital point of energy and 
health.

Target the vital point that brings 
increased charm.
I'm worried, so just cut it out.

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
Hm-hm, the "vital point that'll make a 
strong Uma Musume," is it!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
Then, I'm gonna go stabby-stab, right? Is 
that alright? …Is that reeeeaaaaaaally 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
OK, OK, leave it to me! Come on, bamboo 
needle! Find the secret vital point!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text: Now, relax～… Waaow, Anshi～n☆

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text: Stabby-stab!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Gyaaa―!
The stab was a great success!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm brimming with Bakushin Power…! I feel 
like I'm going to Baku-explode!!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text: …What, success? For real!? Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
No waaay～～～!! How did I just do that, 
seriously!?!? I'm a genius～～～～!!
<chrname> had a newfound sense of power!

Apparently, it seems we've seized the 
possibility. I felt like we made great 
strides towards our dream…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: H, hah…(pant, pant)…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What's this… I don't feel like I can 
Bakushin in the slightest… Hooehhh…
<chrname> is visibly out of shape…

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text: Ahhh～… Well, um… Right?

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text: …Wao, farewell～☆

I shouldn't have gone along with such a 
suspicious offer… And I felt quite a bit 
of regret.

text_block_list.text: Whaaat!? Oh, don't say that～…

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
――Hey, you! Aren't you trespassing on 
campus!?

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text: Gyaaawaa―!? Yikes, they found me!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text: …Waow, I'm out～☆

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text: Ah!? I, I command you to stooop!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What speed…! Just as I expected of a fan 
who's been watching me run!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I must continue to show you my exemplary 
Bakushin!!

I've decided to forget about today's 
incident, since it seems there's no point 
in thinking about who Anshinzawa was…

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, did you make a mistake? Weeell, it 
happens, it happens, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
So, tell me one more time. Which vital 
point will you aim for!?

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text:
You're making me nervous! No, but wait, if 
you're taking this long—

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text: —Hey, you! You're trespassing on campus!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text: What the…? Oh no, they found me!

text_block_list.name: Anshinzawa Sasami
text_block_list.text: … Wow, I'm out!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text: Oh, no! Wait, wait, wait, wait!

… If you've been worrying about it for any 
length of time, it's kind of fizzled out.

She and… <chrname> looked at each other and twisted 
their heads to see what was going on.
